title: Data display: cards, tables, tabs, pagination
asA: user reading and working through collections of content
iWant: data surfaces that stay readable, navigable, and honest about their extent
soThat: I can scan, sort, and move through content without friction

acceptanceCriteria.description: Cards compose token-defined surface, radius, spacing, and elevation; a whole clickable card is a single link with one accessible name, without nested interactive-in-interactive defects.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a clickable card containing secondary actions
acceptanceCriteria.then: the card is one coherent target and secondary actions remain independently operable

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tables render semantic table markup with column headers programmatically associated to cells.
Sortable columns expose sort state visually and via aria-sort, and toggle through ascending and descending predictably.
acceptanceCriteria.then: sort order cycles and both exposures update

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tables ship their own empty, loading (skeleton rows), and error states per spa-REQ-010 rather than collapsing to nothing.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a table in each non-success data state
acceptanceCriteria.then: the designed state fills the table region

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tabs implement the standard pattern: one Tab stop for the tablist, arrow keys move between tabs, selection follows the declared activation mode, and panels are labelled by their tabs.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pattern grammar works with correct ARIA wiring

acceptanceCriteria.description: The active tab is preserved on re-entry where the journey spec declares persistence, via URL or stored state.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a tabbed route with declared persistence
acceptanceCriteria.then: the previously active tab is selected

acceptanceCriteria.description: Pagination controls show current position and total extent where known, disable rather than hide impossible moves, and are fully keyboard operable.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a paginated collection on its first page
acceptanceCriteria.then: previous is disabled with state exposed, position is visible

acceptanceCriteria.description: Page changes update the URL per the canonical shape so paginated positions are shareable and restorable.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user moves to page three and reloads
acceptanceCriteria.then: page three renders from the URL
